description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifierURISchemeCid, which extends HTMLPurifier_URIScheme to implement a Content-ID URI scheme handler within the SuiteCRM project. It manages the validation of 'cid' scheme URIs, often used for embedding referenced content such as images in emails or documents.

classes.name: HTMLPurifierURISchemeCid
classes.description: A URI scheme handler class for 'cid' scheme in SuiteCRM, extending the HTMLPurifier_URIScheme base class to validate 'content-id' URIs used for embedded content.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and normalizes a 'cid' URI by clearing userinfo, port, host, query, and fragment components, returning true upon completion.
